capabilities: Convert markdown files to docx saved directly in the vault
Preserve text styling, headings, lists, tables, blockquotes, and footnotes
Apply syntax highlighting to code blocks using VS Code Default Light colors
Embed local, remote, and Obsidian-style images with custom sizes
Configure fonts, page size, and output folder to match Obsidian appearance
extras: Documents known limitations: PDF embeds are skipped, task checkboxes are static, and collapsible sections are always expanded. v1.4.0 replaced JSZip with fflate to fix iOS Buffer API issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to save a note as a Word document, and existing export paths do not work on mobile or preserve styling.

relations.evidence: Resizer Plugin Integration: Automatically respects custom image sizes

summary: Export plugin that converts Obsidian markdown files to Microsoft Word docx documents with text styling, syntax highlighting, and mobile support.
